# netbox_cooling_outflow_template (Data Source)

Requires NetBox v4.7.0 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_cooling_outflow_template" "example" {
  name           = "example"
  device_type_id = netbox_device_type.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_type_id` (Number)
- `name` (String) At least one of `name` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `cooling_intake_id` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `diameter` (Number)
- `diameter_unit` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `label` (String)
- `module_type_id` (Number)
- `type` (String)
